sloka: गृहीत्वा सलिलं सर्वमुपस्पृश्य यथाविधि ।उत्ससर्ज यथा शापं राक्षसेन्द्राय दारुणम् ।। ७.२६.५५ ॥
transliteration: gṛhītvā salilaṁ sarvamupaspṛśya yathāvidhi ।utsasarja yathā śāpaṁ rākṣasendrāya dāruṇam ।। 7.26.55 ॥

translations.english: Having taken the water and performed the ritual purification, he then uttered a terrible curse upon the king of Rakshasas (Ravana).
